reason: The first reading was corrected and its abbreviations expanded by comparing it line by line with Lombard's text in PL 191.
sources: Petrus Lombardus, Commentarius in Psalmos, PL 191 (Paris 1854), cols. 941-948 (Ps 103:29-104:2) and 965-970 (Ps 105:22-43), archive.org patrologiaecur191mign, leaves n466-n468, n478-n480

text:
F-qslo (Stams, STA, Frg. 213). Source-assisted reading, made with PL 191 in hand. A research reader reread these bands on the image: canvas 0 boxes 2150,380,3500,1150; 2150,2300,3500,2700; 2150,2650,3500,3500; 4100,2450,5250,3300; canvas 1 boxes 1700,2150,3050,3100; 4800,300,6150,1250. Expansions are in parentheses; [..] marks lost text; ? marks uncertain letters.

canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_213_01r), col c, box 4100,2450,5250,3300 (Ps 103:32-33)
[..] in suis .s. q(ue) in eis [facit] qual(ite)r illa faci[at]
Qui respicit t(er)ra(m) & fac(it) ea(m) tremere. q(ui) [tangit]
montes & fumigant. Q(ui) respic(it) m(isericordi)a [terram huma-]
ne ment(is) q(ue) exultabat de bonitate
[sua et sibi ui]res opulentie sue (at?)tribuebat. q(ua)m d(omi)n(u)s
[respicit et] f(acit) ea(m) treme(re). Melior e(st) tremor humi-
[litatis quam c]o(n)fidentia sup(er)bie. Vn(de) ap(osto)l(u)s Cu(m) tremo-
[re operami]ni u(est)ram salute(m). [D(eu)s?] .n. e(st) q(ui) op(er)at(ur) o(mn)ia
[..] e(st) q(ui) tangit c(om)punctione u(e)l amissione

[..]ecta e(st) t(er)ra in sanguinib(us) .i. ho(m)i(n)es q(ui) fere o(mn)es h(oc) pecca[to]

do filios. & contaminata e(st) in op(er)ib(us) eo(rum). c(on)taminati s(unt)
in op(er)ib(us) suis. & fornicati s(unt) in ad(inventionibus) s(uis) .i. polluti s(unt) ad-
ult(er)inis sup(er)stitionib(us) suis q(ua)s dic(it) adinuentio(n)es
eo(rum). n(on) q(uo)d p(ri)mi inuenissent. s(ed) q(ui)a alios imitati s(unt).
q(uo)d greco ap(er)ti(us) d(icitu)r h(ic) & sup(ra) u(bi) d(ixit) irritauer(unt) eu(m) in adi-
uentionib(us) suis. un(de) alii [interpr]etes transfer(unt) studia &

canvas 1 (Stams_STA_Frg_213_01v), col a, box 1700,2150,3050,3100 (Ps 104 title and v. 1)
[..] alias suis locis exequemur. & ph(et)a
[a laude] incipiens q(uam) titulus p(re)notat ait.
Confite(mini) d(omi)no .i. laudate d(omi)n(u)m. q(uo)d fit ab amante.
N(on) e(nim) speciosa laus in ore peccatoris. p(re)missa lau-
de seq(ui)t(ur) inuoc(ati)o ut petat desiderata. & in-
uo(cate) n(omen) ei(us). q(ui)a laudans audiet(ur). C(on)gruu(s) ordo e(st)
iste ut p(ri)us sit laus p(ost) inuoc(ati)o. Vn(de) alibi. C(on)fite-
bim(ur) tibi d(eu)s c(on)fi(tebimur) & inuoc(abimus) n(omen) t(uum). & alibi. Laudans
inuocabo d(omi)n(u)m. & in oratione d(omi)nica p(ro)mittit(ur)
b(re)uis captatio .s. pater n(oste)r q(ui) es in c(e)lis [..] secu(n)t(ur)

canvas 1, col c, box 4800,300,6150,1250 (Ps 105:22; the first line continues "moy-" from F-bjvu)
[moy]ses elect(us) ei(us) stetisset in c(on)fractione in c(on)spectu ei(us).
Et dix(it) ut disp(er)d(er)et eos. p(ro)p(ter) hec scelera dix(it) c(om)minando
ut disp(er)der(et) eos q(ui)a digni erant p(er)ire. Om(ne)s penit(us)
disp(er)deret? ut(ique). Si n(on) moyses electus ei(us) [..]
incessanter orasset p(ro) eis. Stetisset dico in c(on)fracti-
one .i. in plaga q(ua) erant feriendi. s(cilicet) ut se
[ob]iceret p(ro) ill(is) d(icen)s. [Si dimittis] ill(is) h(oc) pecc(atum) d(imitte). si u(ero) n(on)
dimittis ill(is). dele me de libro tuo. ubi monstrat(ur)
q(ua)ntu(m) ualet intercessio s(an)c(t)o(rum). Securus .n. moyses
de iustitia d(e)i q(ua) eu(m) delere n(on) posset [..]
